pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, stellate geometries with multiple acute-angle projections. Edges show sharp pixel gradients. Patches on the lateral flank are larger in spatial area and more rectangular, while those on the ventral neck and chest are more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-radial intersections. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness, tapering slightly at the points of contact between patch vertices.
